facts.text: For fall 2025, University Park admitted 12,096 of 21,321 Pennsylvania applicants and 38,846 of 72,861 out-of-state applicants; 4,674 of the 9,148 enrolled first-years were Pennsylvanians.
Penn State's University Park campus received 106,547 first-year applications for fall 2025, and only 9,148 students enrolled, about one in six admits.
Testing is optional for fall 2027 applicants, and only 28.6% of the fall 2025 enrolled class submitted an SAT and 4.98% an ACT.
2026-27 tuition at University Park is 20,878 for Pennsylvania residents and 44,574 for non-residents, plus 640 in required fees; tuition varies by year of study and by program (CDS G3, G4).
For fall 2025, 1,153 students accepted a place on the waiting list and 46 of them were admitted.

notes: C1 from the University Park CDS 2025-26 (published June 2026): applied 47,811 men + 58,615 women + 121 unknown = 106,547; admitted 25,375 + 33,514 + 63 = 58,952; enrolled 4,456 + 4,691 + 1 = 9,148. The residency rows sum to the totals. The CDS covers University Park only; Penn State's other campuses are not included. psu.edu cost-of-attendance and admissions pages are rendered by JavaScript and returned no figures to curl or WebFetch, so the cost comes from CDS section G (2026-27) with totals null and the test policy from CDS C8A; the C8F clarification text is truncated in the PDF. aidPromise not verified.
